name: repoditor-desktop
description: A desktop save editor for R.E.P.O. .es3 save files.
author: Hans Valerie

scripts.package:tauri: npm run build:sidecar && tauri build --no-bundle -- --locked && node scripts/tauri/stage-tauri.mjs
scripts.package:installer: node scripts/release/check-release-version.mjs && npm run installer:host && node installer/scripts/packaging/prepare-installer.mjs && npm run build:sidecar && tauri build --no-bundle --config build/release-installer/public-editing.json --features public-editing -- --locked && node scripts/tauri/stage-tauri.mjs --public-editing && tauri bundle --config src-tauri/installer.conf.json --bundles nsis --no-sign --no-binary-patching --ci && pwsh -NoProfile -File installer/scripts/packaging/stage-installer.ps1
scripts.test:e2e:recovery: npm run typecheck:e2e && playwright test e2e/tauri/recovery/tauri-recovery.spec.ts --output=build/recovery-checkpoint/native-e2e
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:tauri && npm run typecheck:e2e && cross-env REPODITOR_E2E_EXECUTABLE=build/tauri-portable/RepoDitor.exe playwright test e2e/tauri/startup/tauri-preview.spec.ts e2e/tauri/read-only/tauri-upgrades.spec.ts e2e/tauri/read-only/tauri-run.spec.ts e2e/tauri/read-only/tauri-items.spec.ts e2e/tauri/read-only/tauri-maps.spec.ts e2e/tauri/read-only/tauri-cosmetics.spec.ts e2e/tauri/read-only/tauri-status.spec.ts --output=test-results/tauri-preview
scripts.test: npm run test:imports && npm run test:theme && vitest run
scripts.build:sidecar: uv run --locked --project .. python scripts/tauri/check-meta-anchor.py && uv run --isolated --python 3.13 --project .. --locked --group package pyinstaller --noconfirm --clean --onedir --console --name repoditor-backend --paths python --distpath build/backend --workpath build/pyinstaller/work --specpath build/pyinstaller --collect-all UnityPy --collect-all TypeTreeGeneratorAPI --collect-all fmod_toolkit --collect-data archspec --hidden-import addressablestools --copy-metadata addressablestools python/repo_save_editor/desktop_api/__main__.py
scripts.release:check: node scripts/release/check-release-version.mjs && npm run installer:ui:build && node --test scripts/release/version-tooling.test.mjs
